name: tuck-menu
title: Tuck Menu
description: A full-page menu that waits underneath the page. Open it and the page tucks into a rounded card beside the links. Point at a link and the card previews that page before you pick it. Click the card or press Escape to close.
blurb: The whole page tucks away to show the menu that was underneath.
note: open the menu, then point at a link
